[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 6: Roleplay Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]6.1[/color] Your character is separate from you, the player. Their actions, feelings, and knowledge should be based on their in-character experiences, not your own. ★
[color=#a4885c]6.2[/color] Do not play excessively hostile or provocative characters. Accurate roleplay is never an excuse for rule violations. If you are unsure, Ahelp for clarification. ★
[color=#a4885c]6.3[/color] By selecting a job, you are expected to fulfill the responsibilities of that role whenever reasonably required during the shift. ★
[color=#a4885c]6.3A[/color] Choosing a job implies a commitment to that role for the duration of the shift. Frequently switching between roles is considered a violation of Rule 6.3. ★
[color=#a4885c]6.3B[/color] Transferring to a higher position, such as a Command role, is permitted only with proper in-character justification. Administrative convenience or gameplay necessity alone are not valid reasons. For example, becoming an Overseer solely to perform a deed transfer is not permitted. ★
[color=#a4885c]6.3C[/color] Once a character assumes a Command role, they are expected to remain in that position for the rest of the shift, even if they cryo. You may play other characters in different roles, but the same character may not move from a Command role to another Command position or to a lower role. ★
[color=#a4885c]6.4[/color] Do not intentionally interrupt or disregard roleplay in order to gain an unfair advantage while another player is actively roleplaying or typing. ★
[color=#a4885c]6.4A[/color] Using LOOC to argue about in-game situations or otherwise gain an advantage in roleplay is considered low-roleplay behavior and breaks immersion. For example, arguing in LOOC after being caught breaking into Security. ★
[color=#a4885c]6.4B[/color] Potential rule violations or disputes regarding the legality of actions should not be argued through LOOC. Use Ahelp to seek clarification. If no administrator is available, postpone, cancel, or de-escalate the situation until a ruling can be made. ★
[color=#a4885c]6.5[/color] Respect the consent, dignity, and boundaries of others. If someone asks you through LOOC to stop bothering them, you are expected to do so. If you believe this rule is being abused, Ahelp immediately. ★★
[color=#a4885c]6.6[/color] Do not dismantle critical station infrastructure, such as atmospheric systems, power cables, or other essential components, for non-essential activities without the knowledge and approval of Command. ★★
[color=#a4885c]6.7[/color] Avoid direct references to internet culture, memes, or netspeak in-character. Excessive use of phrases such as "tung tung tung sahur", "skibidi toilet", or similar expressions is considered low roleplay and immersion-breaking. ★★★
